motivo: A normal day, dominated by the first trials of Claude Fable 5.2 (the model was already covered). Three pieces, one per group, and three briefs; the announcements of Claude Whiteboards/Sheets/Data, the INTEF guide and the opening of Gemini 4 Carbon could not be confirmed from an official source.

piezas.titular: A single sentence is enough for Fable 5.2 to produce a photosynthesis animation for sixth-form students
piezas.entradilla: With a single prompt, the model produced a square video with a natural voice aimed at sixth-form students. The author considers it good enough for class and speaks of a new way to create materials.
cuerpo: A member of the group tested [Claude Fable 5.2](pieza:2026-11-09/fable-mythos-5-2), the model Anthropic opened to the general public on 9 November, with a classroom brief: “Make me an animation with a natural voice explaining the process of photosynthesis”, with images that are “extremely detailed and faithful to the science”, a narration that a sixth-form student can follow, good intonation and a square format.

According to their account, the model took about 45 minutes to deliver the video. For the voice they used a free Gemini voice, although all the work was done by Claude. The person who tried it explains that the result depends on what is installed on the computer (voices, fonts, music software) and that is why they gave the agent permission to install whatever it needed.

The experiment was carried out with the console version of Claude, which can operate the computer on its own; in the web version, they said, it is considerably more complicated because it cannot manipulate local files. After reviewing it, the author judged it “more than acceptable” for sixth-form classes.

It remains to be seen how much it costs to use: the group commented that Fable consumes a lot of resources, and the company has given paid subscribers [between one and three usage-limit resets](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-2), depending on the plan and how long they have subscribed.
piezas.comprobado: Anthropic's official page opened: Fable 5.2 available on 9 November to all users and one to three usage resets depending on seniority, this week. Group messages checked against Telegram (#12178). The experiment (prompt, 45 minutes, Gemini voice, console versus web, assessment) is the author's own account; the video has not been seen.

piezas.titular: EduGems becomes EduPrompts because Google is replacing Gems with Skills
piezas.entradilla: The site with 174 prompts for schools changes its name and address. The prompts can still be copied into any other AI tool.
cuerpo: Eric Curts, creator of the prompt site for schools that he launched about a year ago as EduGems, [announced on 9 November its change of name](https://www.controlaltachieve.com/2026/11/eduprompts.html) to EduPrompts. The new address, [eduprompts.ai](https://www.eduprompts.ai/), is already live, and the old one, edugems.ai, will keep working for a while before redirecting.

The reason is that Google is retiring Gems in favour of Skills: current Gems will be converted into Skills and will remain available until Google discontinues them in summer 2027, according to the author. The new name, he explains, better describes what the site offers.

Planned additions include versions of the prompts for Gemini Notebook, which can also be assigned to students, and more prompts, with the option to submit suggestions. Any prompt can be copied and pasted into other AI tools.
A member of the group said that their own collection of prompts has lost its point and that “a good conversation is always better” with the assistant.

piezas.titular: A music-class app asks students to place the notes of a score on the stave
piezas.entradilla: Pentagrama Maestro, created by Iñaki Fernández, plays note by note and offers three levels and unlimited games.
cuerpo: Iñaki Fernández has shared in the group [Pentagrama Maestro](https://sites.google.com/rmsantaisabel.com/pentagrama-maestro/inicio), an app he prepared for music teachers. The exercise consists of placing on the stave the notes that appear in a score.

According to its author, each note plays its sound as it is added and, once the whole stave is solved, a button appears to listen to the entire score. There are three difficulty levels and the games are endless, so students can repeat the exercise without running out of material.
The app is published on a Google Sites page. The page, opened without signing in, does not show the app's content, so its operation is described as its author tells it.
piezas.comprobado: Message #14837 checked on Telegram (author, levels, endless games, sound). The Google Sites page does not show the app's content when opened without signing in: features as described by the author; they could not be tested.

breves.texto: Someone who runs a Claude Code agent on their home NAS says it runs as a service with administrator permissions, and that it asks before deleting data, touching disks or opening ports. It continues [the thread on home automation with agents](pieza:2026-11-09/domotica-agentes-ia).
The website of the National Congress on Digitalisation in Education, held in Albacete on 5 and 6 November, offers access to the broadcast of the talks, according to the group. (In Spanish.)

Anthropic is giving plans that include Fable between one and three usage-limit resets, depending on the length of the subscription, which can be used until 8 March 2027; Pro gets one, only until 16 November. The model is [Fable 5.2](pieza:2026-11-09/fable-mythos-5-2).
